other_addresses_note: None of these is a deployment of record. The five diagnostic addresses are disposable deployments used to see what real validators do with the panel-decided cases; deploy/diagnostics/ holds their runs. The four superseded canonical addresses: the first (15:11Z) had a live run whose own agreement terms set a 60-second appeal window, shorter than the two transactions an appeal takes on StudioNet, so the contract refused the appeal exactly as written - that agreement was then closed through the documented stalled route (UNSETTLED_ADJUDICATION, buyer refunded in full and withdrawn), so it holds no escrow. The second (15:30Z) had an interrupted attempt consume the agreement id AG-000001, which the fixture evidence names inside its own contents. The third (15:43Z) carries the contract as it was before the live readjudication it ran exposed a real fault: a round with every criterion satisfied at 100/100 was held INCONCLUSIVE by an undecided question that could not have changed the verdict. The fix (OUTCOME_INDICATORS) is in the deployment of record; its escrow was returned to the buyer through the stalled route. The fourth (2026-09-12T16:05Z, 0xbB846F3Cc63e0C8fCF138B9CF0e407202158c861) was the deployment of record until its own live run showed validators losing quotes they had copied exactly: its grounding read every line break as an elision and cut an over-long quote once. Diagnostic run four then showed a fault-only question splitting rounds and the panel reading the text of items code had excluded; the deployment of record fixes all three. That run is kept in deploy/superseded/; it held no escrow when it was superseded.
